title: Order
description: An order built by the site. Every amount is a whole number of minor units of its currency. Only the commerce engine writes it.

id.label: ID
id.help: A random id. The order's number is what people see.

number.label: Order Number
number.help: The number buyers and staff see. Counted up from the first order number in Settings → Commerce, and never used twice.

kind.label: Kind
kind.help: A checkout order comes from a cart. A renewal order is built from a subscription when the payment provider reports a renewal payment.

status.label: Status
status.help: Open until it is fulfilled or cancelled.

paymentStatus.label: Payment
paymentStatus.help: Set from what the payment provider reports, never from the buyer's browser.

fulfillmentStatus.label: Fulfillment
fulfillmentStatus.help: Whether the order's lines have been shipped or delivered.

needsAttention.label: Needs Attention
needsAttention.help: Empty, or why a person should look: amount_mismatch, paid_after_expiry, oversold, fulfillment_incomplete, refund_failed or disputed.

currency.label: Currency
currency.help: The three-letter code every amount on this order is in.

customerCollection.label: Customer Collection
customerCollection.help: The auth collection of the buyer's account. Empty for a guest.

customerId.label: Customer ID
customerId.help: The buyer's account. Empty for a guest.

subscriptionId.label: Subscription
subscriptionId.help: The subscription this order started or renewed. Empty when no line recurs.

lines.label: Lines
lines.help: What was bought, as it was at purchase.

subtotal.label: Subtotal
subtotal.help: The lines added up, in minor units, before discount, shipping and tax.

discountTotal.label: Discount
discountTotal.help: The line discounts added up, in minor units. Free shipping is not counted here.

shippingTotal.label: Shipping
shippingTotal.help: The shipping charge, in minor units.

taxTotal.label: Tax
taxTotal.help: The tax charged, in minor units.

grandTotal.label: Total
grandTotal.help: What the buyer pays, in minor units. The payment provider's amount is checked against it.

refundedTotal.label: Refunded
refundedTotal.help: How much has been refunded, in minor units.

taxMode.label: Tax Mode
taxMode.help: none, exclusive or inclusive, as it was when the order was built.

taxLines.label: Tax Lines
taxLines.help: The tax by rate: [{label, rate, amount}].

shippingLine.label: Shipping Line
shippingLine.help: The shipping rate that applied: {rateId, label, amount}.

discountCode.label: Discount Code
discountCode.help: The code used, in uppercase. Empty for none.

discountLine.label: Discount Line
discountLine.help: How the code applied: {code, type, value, amount, shippingWaived, recurring}.

shippingAddress.label: Shipping Address
shippingAddress.help: Where the order ships. Empty when nothing ships.

provider.label: Payment Provider
provider.help: The provider that took the payment, such as stripe.

providerSessionRef.label: Provider Session
providerSessionRef.help: The provider's id for the checkout, such as a Stripe Checkout Session id or a PayPal order id.

providerPaymentRef.label: Provider Payment
providerPaymentRef.help: The provider's id for the payment, set when it is paid.

providerClientSecret.label: Provider Client Secret
providerClientSecret.help: On-page checkout only: the provider session's client secret, so the payment page survives a reload. Cleared when the order leaves pending.

attributes.label: Checkout Attributes
attributes.help: The extra values checkout accepted from the buyer, strings only. Only the names listed in Settings → Commerce are kept.

metadata.label: Metadata
metadata.help: Written by extensions while the order is built. Passed to the payment provider where it allows.

flags.label: Flags
flags.help: Marks for work already done, so it is never done twice: inventoryApplied, receiptQueued, downloadsIssued, paidDispatched.

accessToken.label: Access Token
accessToken.help: A random secret that signs the guest order-status and download links.

notes.label: Internal Notes
notes.help: For staff. Never shown to the buyer.

trackingUrl.label: Tracking Link
trackingUrl.help: Where the buyer can follow the shipment.
